credentialRequirements.description: Firebase access token supplied only within the credential adapter and scoped to the intended projects. The reusable token must never be returned to the proposer.

firebase_create_android_sha.description: Use this to add the specified SHA certificate hash to the specified Firebase Android App.

app_id.description: The Android app ID to add the SHA certificate to.

sha_hash.description: The SHA certificate hash to add (SHA-1 or SHA-256).

firebase_create_app.description: Use this to create a new Firebase App in the currently active Firebase Project. Firebase Apps can be iOS, Android, or Web.

display_name.description: The user-friendly display name for your app. If not provided, a default name may be generated.

platform.description: The platform for which to create an app.

android_config.description: Configuration for Android apps. Required if platform is 'android'.

package_name.description: The package name for your Android app (e.g., com.example.myapp).

ios_config.description: Configuration for iOS apps. Required if platform is 'ios'.

bundle_id.description: The bundle ID for your iOS app (e.g., com.example.myapp).

app_store_id.description: The App Store ID for your iOS app.

firebase_create_project.description: Use this to create a new Firebase Project.

project_id.description: The project ID to create or use.

display_name.description: The user-friendly display name for the project.

firebase_deploy.description: Deploy resources to your Firebase project, based on the contents of firebase.json.

only.description: Comma-separated list of services to deploy. Valid targets are: database, storage, firestore, functions, hosting, remoteconfig, extensions, dataconnect, apphosting, auth.

firebase_init.description: Use this to initialize selected Firebase services in the workspace (Cloud Firestore database, Firebase SQL Connect, Firebase Realtime Database, Firebase AI Logic). All services are optional; specify only the products you want to set up. You can initialize new features into an existing project directory, but re-initializing an existing feature may overwrite configuration. To deploy the initialized features, run the `firebase deploy` command after `firebase_init` tool.

database.description: Provide this object to initialize Firebase Realtime Database in this project directory.

rules_filename.description: The file to use for Realtime Database Security Rules.

rules.description: The security rules to use for Realtime Database Security Rules.

firestore.description: Provide this object to initialize Cloud Firestore in this project directory.

database_id.description: The database ID to use for Firestore.

location_id.description: The GCP region ID to set up the Firestore database.

rules_filename.description: The file to use for Firestore Security Rules.

rules.description: The security rules to use for Firestore Security Rules. Default to open rules that expire in 30 days.

dataconnect.description:
Provide this object to initialize Firebase SQL Connect with Cloud SQL Postgres in this project directory.
It installs SQL Connect Generated SDKs in all detected apps in the folder.

service_id.description: The Firebase SQL Connect service ID to initialize. Default to match the current folder name.

location_id.description: The GCP region ID to set up the Firebase SQL Connect service.

cloudsql_instance_id.description:
The GCP Cloud SQL instance ID to use in the Firebase SQL Connect service. By default, use <serviceId>-fdc. 
Set `provision_cloudsql` to true to start Cloud SQL provisioning.

cloudsql_database.description: The Postgres database ID to use in the Firebase SQL Connect service.

provision_cloudsql.description:
If true, provision the Cloud SQL instance if `cloudsql_instance_id` does not exist already. 
The first Cloud SQL instance in the project will use the SQL Connect no-cost trial. See its terms of service: https://firebase.google.com/pricing.

storage.description: Provide this object to initialize Firebase Storage in this project directory.

rules_filename.description: The file to use for Firebase Storage Security Rules.

rules.description: The security rules to use for Firebase Storage Security Rules. Default to closed rules that deny all access.

ailogic.description: Enable Firebase AI Logic feature for existing app

app_id.description: Firebase app ID (format: 1:PROJECT_NUMBER:PLATFORM:APP_ID). Must be an existing app in your Firebase project.

hosting.description: Provide this object to initialize Firebase Hosting in this project directory.

site_id.description: The ID of the hosting site to configure. If omitted and there is a default hosting site, that will be used.

public_directory.description: The directory containing public files that will be served. If using a build tool, this likely should be the output directory of that tool.

auth.description: Provide this object to initialize Firebase Authentication.

oAuthBrandDisplayName.description: The display name for the OAuth brand.

supportEmail.description: The support email for the OAuth brand.

firebase_login.description: Use this to sign the user into the Firebase CLI and Firebase MCP server. This requires a Google Account, and sign in is required to create and work with Firebase Projects.

authCode.description: The authorization code from the login flow

firebase_logout.description: Use this to sign the user out of the Firebase CLI and Firebase MCP server.

email.description: The email of the account to log out. If not provided, all accounts will be logged out.

firebase_update_environment.description: Use this to update environment config for the Firebase CLI and Firebase MCP server, such as project directory, active project, active user account, accept terms of service, and more. Use `firebase_get_environment` to see the currently configured environment.

project_dir.description: Change the current project directory - this should be a directory that has a `firebase.json` file (or will have one).

active_project.description: Change the active project for the current project directory. Should be a Firebase project ID or configured project alias.

active_user_account.description: The email address of the signed-in user to authenticate as when interacting with the current project directory.
